regions.full_page: Mastoid Phyllis Blake 7 (of 1138 Nottingham Rd G. Point Pk. ), took measles about a month ago. Two weeks later her ears started to run. Last Saturday March 29 was screaming from pain when moth- er phoned to have her enrolled. Improvement followed, but Dr. pronounced double mastoid. She was taken to St. Mary's Hospital 30th March Yesterday, two doctors and two nurses came in to oper ate - little head shaved & all ready. Mother pleads: "Don't cut her." I. And To-day Phyllis is brought to Monastery, smiling, on her way home from Hospital. II. Mother and grandmother came last night and had her name once more inscribed in Mass Assoc'n
